verdict.rationale: Portkey has a dedicated first-party docs page on gateway caching. It claims to serve cached LLM responses "up to 20x faster and cheaper" and supports both simple caching and semantic caching, which matches requests by cosine similarity rather than identical text. Its cost-management page also lists intelligent caching as a way to cut spend. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed and cost savings, and configuration details such as TTL, cache invalidation and per-request controls.
